_about: English one-line lineage of all 41 MiganCore variants (numbering follows the private lineage reference, doc 101). Written from that reference; the long Indonesian fields are in migancore-public.id.json -> lineage. 'family' and 'status' are categories for charts.

statuses.served: Served model (the one in production at closure)
statuses.former-default: Was the default/production model at some point, later replaced
statuses.not-promoted: Measured and explicitly barred from promotion
statuses.component: Building block of a merged model, not served on its own
statuses.never-born: Planned or named, but the model was never produced
statuses.not-judged: Trained or pre-registered, but never measured to a verdict

entries.note: Small, cheap models abandoned for lack of capacity; no numbers attributable to this name.

entries.name: 0.1-qwen3 (cycle 8)
entries.note: First 4B identity cycle: SFT LoRA r=64 on 379 pairs distilled from commercial AI services (~US$2.24). Qualitative evaluation only.

entries.name: 0.2-qwen3 (cycle 9)
entries.note: 807 pairs (537 new + 270 reused); distillation from commercial AI services, estimated at ~US$5-7 plus ~US$0.30; training cost US$0.21. 7/8 on a qualitative test; heavy over-use of tools.

entries.name: 0.3 (Qwen2.5-7B line)
entries.note: Cycles 2-7 used ORPO/SimPO; most iterations of this line were rolled back (F-041).

entries.name: 0.7c
entries.note: Briefly the default, then replaced; archived.

entries.name: 0.7e
entries.note: Not promoted permanently; archived.

entries.name: latest (moving alias, 7B line)
entries.note: A moving tag rather than a version; archived.

entries.name: 0.8 (Qwen2.5-7B line)
entries.note: Not promoted permanently; archived.

entries.name: 0.3-qwen3 (cycle 10)
entries.note: PASS on its cycle gate, then replaced by 0.4-qwen3.

entries.name: 0.4-qwen3 / gen-1 (cycle 11)
entries.note: Promoted to production default; later kept as the cross-generation comparison anchor; replaced by migancore:0.14.

entries.name: 0.5-qwen3 (cycle 12)
entries.note: Rolled back; not promoted.

entries.name: 0.6-qwen3 (cycle 13)
entries.note: PASS as a recovery run, but did not replace 0.4 as default; archived.

entries.name: 0.7-qwen3 (cycle 14)
entries.note: Postponed; the model was never produced.

entries.name: pilot14-irrelevance
entries.note: QLoRA pilot to refuse irrelevant questions without hurting routing or general ability (197 irrelevance + 111 positive examples; one RTX 4090, 46.5 min, US$0.79). Rolled back.

entries.name: pilot15-seimbang (balanced)
entries.note: PASS on the probe, but the decision record keeps it unpromoted; experiment archive.

entries.name: run16-2epoch
entries.note: Not promoted; the result was within noise rather than a clear failure.

entries.name: 0.5-flywheel
entries.note: Artifact of the data-flywheel experiments; never formally promoted.

entries.name: 0.8-8b
entries.note: Served for a while behind grounding/MCP, then replaced; archived.

entries.name: 0.11-4b / v11
entries.note: Production/comparison model for a short time; replaced by v13 and then v14.

entries.name: migancore:0.12-adapter
entries.note: Weak link in the evidence chain; barred as a basis for claims or promotion.

entries.name: migancore:0.12-merged
entries.note: A healthy merge proved the runtime was not the only problem; the one-pot recipe failed and the v12 line was stopped.

entries.name: migancore:0.13 / v13
entries.note: Adjudicated on 10 Sep as PARTIAL PASS; replaced by v14.

entries.name: lora-hitung (arithmetic discipline) v13
entries.note: Component of v13; replaced in v14 by the prompt-variety arithmetic adapter.

entries.name: lora-nalar (reasoning discipline) v13
entries.note: Harmful; removed from the v14 merge.

entries.name: lora-gaya (style discipline) v13
entries.note: Kept: the original v13 style adapter is part of the v14 merge.

entries.name: lora-hitung control (format contract)
entries.note: PASS as a control arm; not a production candidate.

entries.name: lora-hitung weight-decay 0.01
entries.note: PASS without a win = inert; the weight-decay path was closed.

entries.name: lora-hitung epoch-1
entries.note: FAIL; the recipe-dial path was closed and the next lever became prompt variety.

entries.name: lora-hitung prompt-variety
entries.note: PASS and WIN: became the default v14 data recipe and a component of 0.14k/0.14.

entries.name: lora-gaya prompt-variety
entries.note: FAIL; not merged, v14 used the original v13 style adapter.

entries.name: hitung-ajar364 (v13 research variant)
entries.note: Reported as passing, but a one-row gold-label defect limits the claim; not promoted.

entries.name: migancore:0.14k
entries.note: PASS on the local tier-2 gate; same weights as migancore:0.14 (alias).

entries.name: migancore:0.14
entries.note: TIES-merge of the arithmetic (prompt-variety, 285 rows) and style (200 rows) LoRAs. About 50% fabrication on the petak-jujur2 battery (49.9% mean over 40 valid rounds); kept in service because the v15 and v16 candidates failed promotion.

entries.name: migancore:0.14-tool
entries.note: Tool-use specialist branch; never replaced 0.14.

entries.name: migancore:0.14-tool-8b
entries.note: Missed the tool threshold and was poor on hallucination; research archive, barred from promotion.

entries.name: migancore:0.15-tool
entries.note: Early PASS revoked on 30 Aug: FAIL on the regression gate (fabrication 8.4/14 mean over 5 rounds vs <= 8), despite 113/120 on the tool gate.

entries.name: migancore:uji-jujur-1 (V16-JUJUR)
entries.note: NOT A WIN: 60.0% fabrication vs the <= 50% win threshold, statistically indistinguishable from 0.14; archived.

entries.name: migancore:0.16
entries.note: Name reserved for a V16 or V18 promotion that never happened.

entries.name: V17-RLVR / uji-rlvr-1
entries.note: GPU budget ran out at 71% of the merge; the RLVR adapter exists but was never evaluated.

entries.name: MO-GRPO runs (six adapters)
entries.note: None of the six adapters was ever measured, so the main question cannot be judged.

entries.name: V18 / uji-tahan-1
entries.note: Never run; therefore never judged and never called 0.16.
